text:
Alex: quick late-night poll — heading to place a food run for anyone still online. Vote by reacting or reply with the item number. Options:
1) Ramen (tonkotsu)
2) Birria burrito
3) Bagel + schmear
4) Sushi bento
5) Build-your-own salad
6) Nothing, I'm fasting
I plan to order at 22:30 PT.

Morgan: 2) burrito please :raised_hands: (will take extra guac)

Sara: 1) ramen pls :ramen: — chicken if possible

Jamal: 4) sushi bento for me, extra wasabi :sweat_smile: would prefer no ginger

Priya: 3) everything bagel w/lox if it's an option :bagel:

PollBot: Poll created. React with :one: through :six: or reply to cast vote. Poll closes in 15 minutes.

Alex: noted — thanks all. If you want to piggyback send me a DM with any dietary notes.

Morgan: also, I'm happy to cover my part via Venmo.

Alex: payment: send $8 via Venmo @alex-dev or reply 'cover' if someone else is covering you.

Morgan: venmo sent :white_check_mark:

Sara: can someone add extra chili oil pls?

Jamal: I'll grab chopsticks and napkins.

Priya: can we add a bagel with plain cream cheese instead? small swap ok?

Alex: can do — swapping one bagel to plain cream cheese.

PollBot: Reminder: poll closes in 5 minutes.

Alex: placing order now (22:29 PT). ETA ~35m. Thanks folks! :truck:
